narrative:
COGS planning models EUR 20.0B of cost of goods. Budget gross margin is 52.8%.

Network, Energy & Site Costs is the largest cost line at 38% of COGS, driven by sites × energy kwh × tariff + tower and backhaul rentals. Cost drivers are linked to the volume forecast so they flex with the revenue plan.

signals.title: Energy and network inflation is the largest margin swing
signals.source: SDP Scenario Analysis — base growth × ARPU × efficiency × energy
signals.excerpt: In the scenario model, energy and network cost inflation moves operating profit more than any other lever; a price war combined with an energy spike is the downside case.

signals.title: Snowbots closed October overnight
signals.source: SDP Autopilot — Close Sentinel, Variance Explainer, Rolling Forecast
signals.excerpt: By 07:00 the Snowbots had reconciled the October SAP close, drafted the variance commentary and rolled the forecast; three approvals are waiting in the inbox.
